verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM clearly supports bringing your own API keys/subscriptions and swapping between multiple model providers (docs-9, docs-11 'API Access & Keys', gh-1), which covers the BYOK half of the story. However, there is no evidence of any dashboard, log, or feature that surfaces token usage or cost per model or per conversation. Missing for 10: token/cost tracking UI, per-conversation cost breakdown, per-model usage metering, any admin cost-reporting docs.
